a11y
a11y, also known as accessibility, is a term deeply rooted in web development and digital content creation. It refers to various features designed to enhance the usability of web elements and applications for individuals with disabilities. This encompasses a range of attributes and terms used in web development to ensure that websites and digital content are accessible to people with different abilities. Specifically, a11y is a term commonly used in web development to denote accessibility-related features and attributes, including source attributes and other accessibility-related elements that contribute to making web content more usable and inclusive. Accessibility features for web applications are integral to ensuring that users can navigate and interact with digital content effectively, regardless of their physical or cognitive limitations.
